name: Personalized Localized Name Gen
tagline: Invents a fictional name that fits a target country, written in its own script
description: Share a few details about yourself, pick a country, and it invents a fitting fictional identity: a given name, a surname, plus a nickname for cultures that use them, rendered in the local script when there is one. The framing is travel and fiction, an alias for a trip or a character, not impersonation.
author: MarioSaputra
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
